        App

        Display, shortcuts, and guided help.

        Press Q for a new assignment. / focuses the command line for edits like move, due, start, or delete.

        Preferences

        When you finish work

        Choose what happens after you mark an assignment complete.

        When off, marking complete skips the popup and uses the estimated duration as actual time when available.

        Calendar layout

        How the week view looks on the Calendar tab.

        Five-day view always shows weekdays. Seven-day view follows your chosen start day.

        Look & feel

        Theme, command line, and in-app tips.

        Auto-scheduling

        Background refresh keeps times realistic while you are idle.

        Edits reschedule immediately. While idle, background refresh runs one minute after each 5-minute mark (9:51, 9:56, etc.).

            Step 1 of 8

            Welcome to Classify

              Manage Subjects

              Rename subjects, change colors, or remove subjects you no longer use. Removing moves assignments to General.

              Blocked Times

              Tell Classify when school runs, when you are busy, and when days are off. Changes apply to auto-scheduling immediately.

              1. Default school day

              Used every weekday unless a date override or vacation applies.

              2. One-day schedule changes

              Early dismissal, late start, or a different lunch on a specific date.

              Select a date to see current schedule times for that day.
              3. Vacation & days off

              Block full days when school is out — no assignments can be scheduled.

              4. Busy times

              Practices, appointments, or recurring conflicts during the day.
